labels.name: type/verification
labels.description: Needs testing on real hardware or servers

milestones.title: M1 · Daily driver
milestones.description: Everything needed to use Polyphony as the only player with a Subsonic/Navidrome or Jellyfin server, including Cast and DLNA on real hardware.

milestones.title: M2 · Parity
milestones.description: Feature depth people expect from a mature self-hosted music client: more providers, crossfade, equaliser, smart playlists, scrobbling, widgets.

milestones.title: M3 · Beyond
milestones.description: Things no comparable app offers: unified sources, request backends, bandwidth-aware quality, bit-perfect output.

issues.title: Verify Google Cast on real receivers
issues.body:
Cast has only been compiled and unit-tested. Validate on at least a Chromecast / Google TV and a Nest speaker.

- [ ] Session connect, queue hand-off with position, disconnect back to local
- [ ] Per-device profile override applied (check receiver stream URL and codec)
- [ ] Decision change mid-session re-sends the queue when enabled
- [ ] FLAC passthrough vs Opus vs MP3 playback on each receiver
- [ ] Artwork, metadata and remote volume

**Done when** a 30-minute session on each device plays without errors and the quality chip reflects the device rule.

issues.title: Verify DLNA renderers on real hardware
issues.body:
The control point and `DlnaPlayer` are new and only tested against a fake transport. Test with at least three renderer families (TV, AVR or network speaker, a software renderer such as gmrender or BubbleUPnP Server).

- [ ] Discovery on Wi-Fi, expiry, rediscovery after network change
- [ ] SetNextAVTransportURI gapless path and the STOP-detection fallback
- [ ] Seek, pause, volume, track transitions, repeat and shuffle
- [ ] Codec fallback from the renderer's protocol info
- [ ] Hand-off local → DLNA → local and Cast interplay

Record renderer quirks in `core/dlna/README.md`.

issues.title: Verify Jellyfin provider against a live server
issues.body:
Run the full flow against Jellyfin 10.10 and 10.11 (and server 12 when released).

- [ ] Login, library sync, artist/album/track mapping, artwork
- [ ] Universal audio stream URL for every built-in profile; confirm direct play vs transcode
- [ ] Favourites, playlists (create, add, remove by index, rename), lyrics, instant mix
- [ ] Playback reporting shows up in the server dashboard
- [ ] Deprecated `/Artists/AlbumArtists` fallback path

issues.title: Large-library performance pass (50k+ tracks)
issues.body:
Validated with a tiny library only. Build or borrow a 50k-track library and profile.

- [ ] Initial sync time and memory; batch sizes and transactions
- [ ] Songs tab and search with Paging 3 instead of full lists
- [ ] Artwork request throttling and memory cache sizing
- [ ] Home queries (recently played joins, seeded random) under 16 ms
- [ ] Scroll jank measured with Macrobenchmark

**Done when** cold start to Home is under 1.5 s and all lists scroll at 60 fps on a mid-range device.

issues.title: Baseline Profiles and startup profile
issues.body: Add a `baselineprofile` module with Macrobenchmark journeys (cold start, Home scroll, open album, play, expand player) and ship the generated profile with release builds.

issues.title: Playback robustness: process death, queue restore, resume
issues.body:
- [ ] Kill the process while playing and resume from the notification
- [ ] Reboot and resume via media button / Bluetooth
- [ ] Queue, index, position and shuffle order restored
- [ ] Playback resumption from Android's media resumption UI
- [ ] No duplicate notifications or stale sessions

issues.title: Bluetooth, headset buttons and audio focus with navigation apps
issues.body: Validate pause on disconnect, resume on connect (setting), single/double/triple press, ducking during navigation prompts, and focus loss from calls.

issues.title: Android Auto: verify browse tree and playback
issues.body: Test with the Desktop Head Unit and a car. Browse tree currently exposes Recently added, Favourites and Playlists; add Albums and Artists with artwork, and voice search handling (`onSearch`).

issues.title: Tune adaptive latency thresholds on real networks
issues.body: Thresholds (3 stalls / 120 s, 4 s long stall, 10 min recovery) are guesses. Reproduce on LTE and a throttled Wi-Fi, log decisions, and tune presets. Consider a short debounce before the first downgrade and surfacing the event in the player.

issues.title: Bandwidth-aware quality selection
issues.body: Feed ExoPlayer's bandwidth estimate and measured time-to-first-byte into the decision engine so quality can step down before a stall, and step back up when headroom returns. Expose as a rule ("Auto") alongside the fixed profiles.

issues.title: Download location migration (internal ↔ external)
issues.body: Changing `DownloadLocation` currently leaves files where they are. Move completed files in a worker with progress, update paths atomically, and handle missing external storage gracefully.

issues.title: Download rules: deleted targets, conflicts and eviction messaging
issues.body:
- [ ] Rule whose playlist/album/artist no longer exists: mark it, do not remove files silently
- [ ] Pinned download that a rule also wants: keep pinned, show both
- [ ] When eviction removes items, tell the user what and why (notification + Downloads screen banner)
- [ ] Evaluate rules for all servers, not only the active one

issues.title: Downloads: speed, ETA and per-item retry details
issues.body: Show transfer rate and ETA on the Active tab and in the notification; expose the last error per item with a retry action.

issues.title: In-app crash and diagnostics log export
issues.body: There is deliberately no analytics. Capture uncaught exceptions and the last few hundred log lines (decisions, sync phases, player errors) to app storage and offer "Export diagnostics" in About, redacting URLs and tokens.

issues.title: Release pipeline: signed builds and GitHub Releases
issues.body:
- [ ] Keystore from repository secrets, `assembleRelease` with R8
- [ ] Tag-triggered workflow publishing APK + checksums to a GitHub Release
- [ ] Version bump script and changelog from conventional commits
- [ ] Beta track (pre-release tags)

issues.title: F-Droid submission and reproducible builds
issues.body: Fastlane metadata exists. Add the F-Droid build recipe, verify the build is reproducible, and submit. Document the `signing` expectations in the README.

issues.title: Jellyfin Quick Connect login
issues.body: Offer Quick Connect as an alternative to password login in the connect flow using the SDK's quick-connect APIs; poll for approval with a visible code.

issues.title: Accessibility pass
issues.body: TalkBack labels on every icon button, 48 dp touch targets, font scaling up to 200 % without clipping, reduced-motion respect for the player sheet, contrast check on artwork-tinted surfaces.

issues.title: Instrumentation tests for Room DAOs and sync
issues.body: Add `androidTest`s for the FTS search, sort variants, seeded random, sync generation deletion and offline index queries; run them in CI on an emulator.

issues.title: Lint and static analysis in CI
issues.body: `:app:lintDebug` currently produces no report under AGP 9; configure the report output, add detekt with a baseline, and fail CI on new errors.

issues.title: Battery audit for overnight playback
issues.body: Measure drain during 8 hours of streaming and of downloaded playback; check wake locks, the position ticker when the UI is hidden, and network callbacks.

issues.title: Crossfade between tracks
issues.body: ExoPlayer has no native crossfade. Evaluate (a) two ExoPlayer instances with volume ramps and (b) a custom `AudioSink` mixing the next track's decoded audio. Must preserve gapless for album playback and work with ReplayGain. Settings already expose `crossfadeMs`.

issues.title: Built-in equaliser with presets
issues.body: 10-band equaliser plus bass boost and loudness using `android.media.audiofx` on the player's audio session, with per-output presets (local, Bluetooth device name) and a Compose editor.

issues.title: Plex provider
issues.body: Implement `MediaProvider` for Plex Media Server music libraries: plex.tv PIN auth, server discovery, library sections, metadata mapping, transcode decision via `/music/:/transcode/universal/start`, ratings, playlists, scrobbling. Register the factory in a new `provider:plex` module.

issues.title: Emby provider
issues.body: Emby's API is close to Jellyfin's; start from `provider:jellyfin` with a hand-written client (the Jellyfin SDK is not compatible).

issues.title: Kodi provider
issues.body: JSON-RPC over HTTP/WebSocket for the music library, with streaming via the Kodi web server (`vfs`).

issues.title: Local files provider (MediaStore)
issues.body: Treat on-device music as a server-less provider: MediaStore scan into the same Room cache, embedded artwork, folder browsing, SAF for external storage. Downloads and local files should unify in offline mode.

issues.title: Smart playlists and filter builder
issues.body: Rule-based playlists evaluated over the local database: fields (genre, year, rating, play count, last played, added, duration, codec, bitrate), operators, AND/OR groups, sort and limit. Live results, pin to Home, use as a download rule target.

issues.title: Star ratings (1–5) across the app
issues.body: The model and providers support ratings; add rating controls to track options, album header, Now Playing overflow and a "Highest rated" Home section. Jellyfin maps to like/dislike.

issues.title: Multi-artist, album artist and composer browsing
issues.body: OpenSubsonic `artists[]`/`albumArtists[]` and Jellyfin `ArtistItems` are parsed but flattened. Model many-to-many artist links, show all artists on tracks, and add a Composers tab option.

issues.title: Embedded and LRC lyrics, and lyrics providers
issues.body: Read lyrics from downloaded files' tags and sidecar `.lrc`, cache server lyrics locally, and add an optional LRCLIB fallback with a per-server toggle.

issues.title: Bookmarks and resume position for long tracks
issues.body: Remember position for tracks longer than N minutes (audiobooks, mixes), expose Subsonic bookmarks, and show a resume prompt.

issues.title: Podcasts and internet radio (Subsonic)
issues.body: Subsonic exposes podcast channels/episodes and internet radio stations. Add capabilities, screens and playback (live streams need a separate buffering profile).

issues.title: Last.fm and ListenBrainz scrobbling
issues.body: Client-side scrobbling in addition to server reporting: queue scrobbles offline, submit with backoff, now-playing updates, per-service toggles and auth screens. Cassette's ListenBrainz client is a useful reference for the API shape.

issues.title: Home-screen widgets
issues.body: Glance widgets: now playing with controls (small and large), and a "recently added" grid. Theme with Material You.

issues.title: Tablet and foldable layouts
issues.body: Navigation rail at medium width, two-pane library/detail, Now Playing as a side panel on expanded screens, posture-aware player on foldables.

issues.title: Wear OS companion controls
issues.body: Media controls and queue browsing on the watch via the Media3 session; later, offline sync of selected playlists to the watch.

issues.title: Tasker, app shortcuts and intents
issues.body: Static and dynamic shortcuts (shuffle all, favourites, last playlist), documented intents for play/pause/next/set profile, and Tasker plugin actions.

issues.title: Settings backup and restore
issues.body: Export servers (with an optional passphrase for credentials), settings, transcoding profiles, device overrides and download rules to a file; import on a new device.

issues.title: Multiple libraries per server
issues.body: Jellyfin libraries and Subsonic music folders are currently merged. Let users pick which to sync and filter by library in the Library screen.

issues.title: Playlist editing: drag reorder, bulk select, duplicates
issues.body: Reorder playlist tracks with persistence to the server, multi-select to add/remove, duplicate detection when adding.

issues.title: Queue: history, undo remove, play-next grouping
issues.body: Show previously played items above the current one, offer undo after swipe-to-remove, and group "play next" insertions visually.

issues.title: Sleep timer: fade-out and shake-to-extend
issues.body: Fade volume over the last 30 s, optional "finish track" (exists), and a quick-extend affordance from the notification.

issues.title: Localisation infrastructure
issues.body: All strings are in resources. Set up Weblate (or Crowdin), add `locales_config.xml`, and ship the first community translations.

issues.title: Unified sources: Downloaded / Library / Streaming toggle
issues.body: Generalise offline mode into a three-way scope. "Streaming" adds catalog-only providers (see the Spotify issues) whose items can be played through an external route and saved to either the streaming library or the home library via a request backend.

issues.title: Spotify catalog and library via Web API
issues.body: PKCE login with the user's own developer app, search, saved albums/tracks/playlists, save-to-library. Catalog-only provider capability (no stream URLs). Track Spotify API policy changes.

issues.title: Spotify playback: App Remote or Music Assistant bridge
issues.body: Decide between (a) Spotify App Remote SDK (playback inside the Spotify app, our UI controls it) and (b) registering the phone as a Music Assistant player (Sendspin) so MA streams Spotify and other services. Embedding librespot is out of scope for licensing reasons.

issues.title: Lidarr "add to home library" requests
issues.body: From any catalog item: resolve to MusicBrainz, add artist/album to Lidarr monitored, trigger search, show queue/import status, and surface the item once the next library sync finds it.

issues.title: slskd / Soulseek search and download requests
issues.body: Search slskd, pick a result with quality hints, enqueue the download, and track completion; hand off to the library import path.

issues.title: Music Assistant player bridge (Sendspin)
issues.body: Implement the Sendspin player protocol so Polyphony appears as a player in Music Assistant, enabling MA's providers (Spotify, Tidal, Qobuz, YouTube Music) to stream to the phone.

issues.title: Bit-perfect USB DAC output
issues.body: Custom `AudioSink` that opens the USB DAC directly (AAudio/Oboe exclusive mode or `AudioTrack` with matching sample rate and bit depth) to avoid system resampling and mixing. Device compatibility matrix required.

issues.title: Provider plugin interface documentation and contributor guide
issues.body: Document `MediaProvider`/`MediaProviderFactory` with a walkthrough of adding a backend, the capability flags, URL/auth expectations for Cast and DLNA, and testing patterns. Add CONTRIBUTING.md and issue templates.

issues.title: Library: genre pages with mosaics and multi-genre tracks
issues.body: Tracks can carry several genres (OpenSubsonic `genres[]`). Store them, show genre tiles with 4-up artwork mosaics, and filter by any of a track's genres.

issues.title: Artist pages: discography sections, appears-on, biography sources
issues.body: Split albums / EPs / singles / compilations, add "Appears on" from track-level artist links, and fall back to a secondary biography source when the server has none.

issues.title: Reduced data mode and image quality controls
issues.body: On metered networks, request smaller artwork and defer non-essential prefetching; expose an "artwork quality" setting.

issues.title: Headphone and output presets for transcoding profiles
issues.body: Extend per-device rules from Cast/DLNA to local outputs: pin a profile to a Bluetooth device name or to wired/USB output, so lossless goes to the DAC and Opus to earbuds.

issues.title: Shared listening: queue hand-off between phones
issues.body: Export the current queue and position as a link or QR so another Polyphony install on the same server can continue playback.
